(c) User (team) CRUD — POST creates user with id 'u_<8hex>' (note: spec said 12hex, actual code uses 8hex — cosmetic mismatch, not blocking), password<6 rejected (422), duplicate email 409, PATCH updates fields, reset-password rehashes and login succeeds with new password, self-delete blocked (400 'own account'), delete of arjun (has active jobs) blocked (400 with 'active job(s)' detail), team member is 403 on all mutating user endpoints. (d) SOP seed — GET /api/sops returns 20+ items (actual: 20) and includes all 15 required titles ('LinkedIn Ad Campaign Setup' … 'Emergency Client Escalation'), all with non-empty steps. Arjun sees no nav-team, no new-client-btn, no per-card client controls, and /team route redirects to /dashboard. Full UI create-client + create-team-member flows validated end-to-end (toast 'Client TEST_UIClient added' + new card rendered; team card count went 6→7 after create).
critical_code_review_comments: Spec says new user id is 'u_<12hex>' but backend uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] (server.py line 274). Cosmetic mismatch — update either spec or code to match.

Team.jsx: role_key select lets a non-admin be assigned role_key='manager' while keeping is_admin=false — form.is_admin OR-forces true only when the row is *changed to* manager (Team.jsx L37); an admin editing an existing manager and changing role could accidentally decouple role_label 'Manager' from is_admin. Consider forcing is_admin=true whenever role_key==='manager' and disabling the admin checkbox in that case.

delete_client only checks active/todo/review/overdue statuses. Jobs with status 'done' still linked to a deleted client will become orphaned (client field references a non-existent client id). Consider either cascade-nulling or blocking on ANY jobs.
reset_password endpoint has no rate limit and returns 200 with no audit log entry — a compromised manager token could silently reset all passwords. For an internal MVP acceptable, but flag for prod.
server.py has grown to 831 lines with clients/users/attachments/AI/inbox all in one module — violates the <700 line guideline. Split into routers.
Legacy code-smells from prior iterations persist: deprecated @app.on_event, seed_data.py bcrypt hashing at import time.
